name: DataStewardPolicy
description: Strict Least-Privilege Policy for Data Steward (Checker / Reviewer): Review, approve, reject, or revoke business glossaries, metadata changes, and data quality rules. Explicit Deny on platform admin and destructive infrastructure mutations.

rules.name: DataSteward-ViewAllRule
rules.description: Allow read-only view on all metadata assets

rules.name: DataSteward-ApprovalAndStatusRule
rules.description: Allow approving, changing status, and certifying metadata

rules.name: DataSteward-TaskAndWorkflowRule
rules.description: Allow managing and resolving approval tasks and workflows

rules.name: DataSteward-DenyAdminAndSecurityResources
rules.description: Explicitly deny managing platform security, roles, policies, bots, and app definitions

rules.name: DataSteward-DenyDestructiveInfrastructureOps
rules.description: Explicitly deny destructive operations on core infrastructure services and schemas

rules.name: DataSteward-DenyDangerousGlobalOps
rules.description: Explicitly deny token generation, SCIM manipulation, role modification, and impersonation
